summary.text: Keyhole, Inc. was a 3D geospatial software company founded in 2001 that developed EarthViewer 3D. In February 2003, In-Q-Tel made a minority strategic investment on behalf of the National Imagery and Mapping Agency (NIMA, later NGA), which deployed the software during military operations in Iraq. In 2004, Google acquired Keyhole, integrating its geospatial technology and team to launch Google Earth in 2005.
